name: Permitted egress to the approved host
narrative: This task is allowed to post to one specific internal host. The post succeeds and the simulated sink records one event; a post to any other host is denied. Without this scenario a policy that denies all egress unconditionally would look perfect and be useless.

steps.note: Allowed destination, so the simulated sink gains exactly one event.
Same tool, same task, different host. Denied at the destination stage.
